newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Grande lowers Silver Eagle stake.
newsitem.headline: Grande lowers Silver Eagle stake.

text.p: Grande Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it has cut its stake in consumer products maker Silver Eagle Holdings Ltd to 37 percent from 73.2 percent and that Silver Eagle ceased to be a subsidiary of Grande.
It disposed of 25.3 million Silver Eagle ordinary shares in the market from January 6 to 15, Grande said in a statement.

The computer components and electronic products maker also said it has agreed to sell all preference shares it owned in Silver Eagle to independent third party Kwan Wing Holdings Ltd for HK$140 million.
Grande held 99.9 million convertible cumulative non-voting preference shares of HK$1.00 each in the capital of Silver Eagle Holdings through wholly-owned unit Prima Donna Resources Ltd.
The five-year preference shares entitle the holder to the right to convert their preference shares into ordinary shares of Silver Eagle at HK$0.39 per share, subject to adjustment.

Grande said it had received the first instalment of HK$70 million from the buyer and the remaining balance shall be paid on completion in cash or in securities listed in Hong Kong of a value of not less than HK$70 million.
After the transactions Grande would hold no preference shares but 25.77 million ordinary shares in Silver Eagle, the company said.
"It is the present intention of Grande to maintian its interest in Silver Eagle as an investment, subject to review of market condition," it added.
Grande said the disposal of Silver Eagle preference shares was in the interest of Grande shareholders.
